text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page PDR-4821 fired for dedicated-us-west-2 — sustained 429 responses and queue depth surge. Trigger: 429 rate >10% (3m), avg latency >1200ms. Metrics: https://redwood.monitoring/alerts/PDR-4821

Alice: acked. I'm on it, pulling dashboards now.

Raj: on call, taking warm-handoff. Any known customer impact?

incident-bot: Acknowledged by Alice (auto-ack).

Maya: initial look — KV cache eviction noise on pool-17 coinciding with a recent model rollout. Fuzzy-route fallback started diverting traffic to quantized small variant (gpt-small-qs) which can't handle the burst, causing upstream backpressure -> 429s.

Raj: ok, plan A: scale dedicated pool +2 nodes, plan B: disable fuzzy-route fallback temporarily and throttle incoming queue. Who can run scale?

Alice: running scale now:
```
/redwood scale dedicated-pool dedicated-us-west-2 --delta 2 --reason "PD PDR-4821 429 spike"
```

pagerbot: scaling job submitted (job id 4242). Provisioning estimate ~90s.

Maya: pushing a quick routing policy change to stop fuzzy routing for this pool for 5m and tighten per-node concurrency. Patch: set fallback.max_concurrent_per_node=40 and disable fuzzy for 300s.
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/routing/disable_fuzzy -d '{"pool":"dedicated-us-west-2","ttl":300}'
```

Raj: new nodes are booting, I see queue depth falling 1200 -> 300 within the last minute. 429s trending down.

Alice: notifying CS. Luis, can you prepare a short customer blurb? Affected window roughly 13:02–13:07 PST, gen endpoints only.

Luis: on it — will mention elevated latency and intermittent 429s for gen endpoints, no embeddings impact. Drafting now.

Maya: recommendation: revert the model rollout on pool-17 and add kvcache eviction guard in the rollout pipeline; also add a routing circuit-breaker to avoid sending to tiny variants during autoscaling events. Adding runbook note.

Alice: enabled temporary client-side retry header and increased jitter/backoff on edge for 10m. Monitoring traces.

pagerbot: Job 4242 completed successfully — 2 nodes added. Health checks passing.

Raj: 429 rate under 0.5% for the last 2m, latency back to baseline. I'll take a 2-hour watch and own follow-up runbook + postmortem starter if it recurs. Handing over from Alice.

Alice: thanks — handing off to Raj for night watch. I will update the PD timeline and close my loop.

Luis: customer note sent to affected tenants, included timeline and mitigation steps. Will update if we need more follow-ups.

Raj: taking ownership. Runbook note: "ded-pool-kvcache-eviction" created, action items assigned to Maya (routing fix) and Alice (rollout revert).

Alice: closing PD incident PDR-4821 in the UI. Thanks team :thumbsup: :tada:

Raj: acknowledged handoff, will escalate if patterns reappear.
